item.title: Alas, I am not Fern Brady
item.description: Your Task The Original The Instrumental Cover Version The Full Version of the Task What Have We Learnt Today? Your Task Perform the best instrumental cover version of “It’s me, Fern Brady, me Fern Brady!” from the “Write a classic song” task. This task appeared in Episode 4 of Series 14 of UK Taskmaster. Bonus points are also available for providing a convincing extension to the original. Best instrumental cover version wins the task!
